This is based on the implementation of Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct found here. This repository contains scripts for optimized on-device export suitable to run on Qualcomm® devices. sources.title: Qwen2.5 7B: GGUF size, RAM & VRAM requirements · localmodel.run
sources.snippet: What is the Q4_K_M GGUF file size of Qwen2.5 7B? The Q4_K_M GGUF file is about 4.68 GB to download, and the Q8_0 GGUF is about 8.1 GB. That is the weights file on disk; to run it you also need room for the KV cache and overhead, so budget ~6.1 GB of memory at Q4_K_M.
